zpnbc7: Original SpanishCue text. Read to understand the experience and the decision; then go back to the details.
2zy4x: I got to my sister's wedding with a borrowed backpack and a story nobody expected. I had prepared the trip a week ahead: I bought an early ticket and packed my suit in a small suitcase. The night before, I looked at the schedule, but I didn't open the notice the company had sent by email. I thought it was advertising and kept making dinner.
jc3md4: When I got to the station, the board showed that my train was leaving from another terminal. An employee explained that they had changed the departure because of roadworks. While she was pointing out the way, I heard the announcement of the last call. I ran to the platform, but the doors were already closed. I didn't miss the train by arriving late at the station; I missed it because I hadn't checked the change.
13tevqg: At the office they offered me a seat three hours later. A traveler who had overheard the conversation suggested sharing a taxi to the next station. Before accepting, we checked that the train stopped there. We managed to catch it, although my suitcase stayed by the counter. My sister lent me clothes and, finally, I was able to be with her. Since then I read notices in full and no longer rely only on the schedule I remember.
